eyebrow: An AI clinical co-pilot for the Indian visit
title: Diagnose.
summary: An AI clinical co-pilot that drafts a differential grounded in India-first guidelines — the doctor still decides.
description: Buddhi listens to the visit, drafts a differential grounded in India-first guidelines, and hands it to the doctor to decide. Currently an early concept — scoping the problem with early hospital conversations before committing to a build.
painHeading: Two minutes, a fever, three possible causes — and a note that gets shorter every time volume goes up.
painDescription: The patient describes their symptoms in Telugu, switches to English mid-sentence, and the doctor is already thinking about the next twenty people in the waiting room. Whatever gets typed in that window has to carry the differential, the plan, and the record — in a system built for single-language, unhurried input. Tools built somewhere else don't fix this: they carry someone else's guidelines, someone else's tests, and English-only listening into a visit that runs on none of those.
solutionHeading: Describe the visit. Get the draft — never the decision.

features.title: Listens in the language actually spoken
features.description: Code-switched, multi-language, real-time — built around how Indian consultations actually sound, not accented English.

features.title: Reasons like it trained here
features.description: Grounded in India-first guidelines, tests, and formulary data — never a foreign default quietly standing in for local practice.

features.title: Sees more than the conversation
features.description: Labs, imaging, vitals, medication and visit history — where available — inform the same picture as the transcript, not a separate silo.

features.title: Never finalizes without the doctor
features.description: Every item is a draft. Nothing reaches the record, and nothing is prescribed, until a registered practitioner says so.

features.title: Follows the patient, with their consent
features.description: A history from any ABDM-linked facility — not just ones running Buddhi — joins the same picture, so a first visit doesn't start from a blank page.

features.title: Add to your own record
features.description: A prescription or report from a visit we couldn't reach any other way — photographed and added by the patient, mapped straight into the same history.

compliance.heading: Owned by you. Shared on your terms.
compliance.description: Every hospital you've ever visited keeps its own file on you — and none of them talk to each other. Buddhi flips that: the record travels with the patient, not the building, and no one sees it without a yes given right then, not a box ticked once and forgotten.

items.description: A new hospital sees nothing until you say so — there and then, not by default.
A prescription or report from somewhere we haven't reached yet — added by you, mapped straight into your own history.

items.tag: Protected like it's the only copy
items.description: Encrypted and logged — because it's your record sitting there, not a hospital's.

visionHeading: The consult is where we're starting. Not where we stop.
visionDescription: What Buddhi is meant to become — holding a lot more of how a hospital practices medicine — is scope we'll earn one design partner, one specialty, one language at a time, once the build starts. What's public today is a fraction of the thinking, not the product.

facts.description: Scoping the problem with early hospital conversations, before committing to a build.
Built by a technical founder with a background in enterprise-scale platform architecture.
Not a global product with local settings changed — built here, for here, first.

closingHeadline: The visit shouldn't be a trade-off between documenting and diagnosing.

title: Reconciled overnight.
summary: Solvent reads your GSTR-2A/2B, vendor invoices, and books, then prepares the reconciliation, exceptions, and filing packet — ready for review.
description: Solvent reads your GSTR-2A/2B, your vendor invoices, and your books — then prepares the reconciliation, the exceptions, and the filing packet, ready for review. The manual version costs Indian businesses 15–20 hours and a 15–20% error rate every month. Solvent does it before your coffee's cold — not a smarter spreadsheet, an employee that never sleeps on close day.
painHeading: You've matched GSTR-2A against your books by hand, again, this month — for every client, every mismatch, every line.
painDescription: Most of a small business's monthly accounting bill is staff time spent on data entry, not advice. GST and TDS reconciliation still runs on manual matching, one line at a time, across every client, every month.
solutionHeading: Work comes in. Solvent prepares it. Your team signs off.

features.title: Reads what your team already uses
features.description: Your accounting software, the GSTN portal, TRACES — Solvent works inside your existing stack through a dedicated connector for each one. No new system for your team to learn, no data migration to plan.

features.title: Matches every return before you do
features.description: GSTR-2A and 2B reconciled against your books automatically, vendor GSTINs validated, and every input tax credit checked before it's claimed — not after a notice arrives.

features.title: Flags exceptions, not just errors
features.description: Every mismatch arrives with the context to decide in seconds — what it is, why it happened, and what the fix looks like — instead of a raw list your team has to investigate cold.

features.title: Never files without your sign-off
features.description: Every return, every payment, every reconciliation is prepared and reviewer-ready — and stays a draft until someone on your team approves it. Always.

compliance.heading: Built to be audited, not just trusted
compliance.description: This is compliance work — the standard is what a CA firm's own auditor, or a GST officer, would expect to see, not just what a typical SaaS product ships with.

items.description: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit. Every document, ledger entry, and reconciliation record encrypted end to end.
Role-based access per firm and per client, 2FA on every account — a firm's junior staff sees only what their role permits.
Every read, edit, approval, and rejection immutably logged with actor, timestamp, and before/after state — not just a summary report.
Hosted in India, per-client data isolation by design — Client A's books are never reachable from Client B's workspace.
The approval step is a system-level gate, not a policy suggestion — the AI cannot mark its own work as filed or approved.
SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 targeted post-seed, as the customer base that requires them is onboarded — not claimed before they're earned.

compliance.note: This is the standard we're building to before asking a firm to trust us with a live filing — not a claim that it's all live today.

visionHeading: GST reconciliation is where we start. Not where we stop.
visionDescription: Every workflow we add — TDS, accounts payable, month-end close — is judged the same way: does it hold up against what a careful accountant would actually do, not just what looks automated. Underneath, GST and TDS are a compliance plugin on a core engine that doesn't change per country — India is where we're proving it first, not where the platform ends.

facts.description: Actively building, working toward first design partners among CA firms and business owners.
Built by a technical founder with a background in enterprise-scale platform architecture.
GST, TDS, and DPDP-aligned data residency built in from the start, not bolted on later.

closingHeadline: Building for CA firms, finance teams, and business owners done reconciling by hand.

title: Every question answered.
summary: Nexara closes the sale inside the conversation — recovering stalled carts and handling the objections that block a purchase, grounded in your real catalog and order data — priced on outcomes, not raw AI replies.
description: Nexara doesn't just answer from your catalog — it closes. It recovers carts before they're gone, handles the objections that actually stall a purchase, and lets shoppers buy without leaving the conversation, grounded in your real product and order data the whole way through. Most AI support tools bill you for the reply, then bill you again for the ticket it creates, whether that reply helped or not. Nexara prices differently: a small fixed platform fee, plus a component tied to outcomes you actually get.
painHeading: You just found out "1,000 AI resolutions" can cost well over a thousand dollars a month on a typical per-resolution AI support plan — because every AI reply gets billed as an AI charge and a support ticket, on top of the plan you're already paying for.
painDescription: Most AI support pricing charges you per interaction, whether that interaction actually helped or not — a base helpdesk plan plus AI resolutions billed individually, often $0.90–$1.00 each, with every AI reply billed twice: once as an AI charge, once as a support ticket.
solutionHeading: A shopper stalls. Nexara handles the objection, closes the sale — and you're billed for what it actually got done.

features.title: Connects to your catalog, not a config file
features.description: Product data, variants, inventory, and order history sync straight from the Shopify Admin API — no separate database to maintain, no re-tagging your catalog to make the bot work.

features.title: Answers only what's actually true
features.description: Every reply is grounded in your real product and order data — price, stock, variant availability, shipping status. If it isn't in your store's data, Nexara says so instead of guessing.

features.title: Recovers the sale before it's gone
features.description: Proactive nudges to shoppers who stall on a product page or leave items idle in cart — the same job most AI support tools charge separate add-ons for, included in the fixed platform fee here.

features.title: Sells without leaving the conversation
features.description: Product cards, real prices, and an add-to-cart button live in the chat window — a shopper who's convinced doesn't have to go find the product page again to buy it.

features.title: Handles the objection, not just the question
features.description: Shipping cost doubts, return-policy hesitation, fit uncertainty — the specific things that stall a purchase — get addressed directly and proactively, not just answered if asked.

features.title: Guides shoppers who don't know what they want yet
features.description: A short, conversational set of questions — skin type, occasion, budget, fit — routes a browsing shopper to the right product, weighted by what's actually trending in your catalog right now, not just what's alphabetically first. The same job a separate quiz app does, built into the conversation instead of a second tool to configure.

features.title: Hands off the moment it should
features.description: Anything outside its confidence — a return dispute, a custom order, a frustrated customer — routes straight to your inbox or Slack with the full conversation attached. It never fakes a resolution to look useful.

features.title: Reads intent, reports outcome
features.description: Every conversation becomes structured signal, not just a transcript — the objection that stalled a purchase, the question your catalog doesn't answer yet, the intent behind a browse that never became a search. Only three things ever get billed: a resolved question, a recovered cart, a completed order — everything else is signal, not spend.

features.title: Gets sharper with every conversation
features.description: Every resolved objection and every human correction updates your store's own knowledge base — not a shared model across stores, per the promise above. The next shopper gets a sharper answer; no other merchant's catalog benefits from what happened in yours.

compliance.heading: Built to be trusted with your storefront, not just installed on it
compliance.description: This runs on live customer conversations, order data, and purchases made inside the chat — the standard is what a careful support lead and a careful finance lead would both expect to see, not just what a typical support bot ships with.

items.description: Shoppers trust a retailer's own on-site AI agent three times more than third-party AI shopping agents, per industry research — reason enough to own this relationship directly, not outsource it.
Checkout happens on Shopify's own secure, PCI-compliant checkout — Nexara never sees, stores, or processes card numbers, even when the sale starts inside the chat.
Your catalog, conversations, and quiz responses are never used to train a shared model across stores.

items.tag: Every billed outcome, backed by evidence
items.description: Every AI reply, escalation, and handoff is logged with a timestamp and the data it was grounded in — and every outcome on your invoice links back to the exact transcript that earned it. Nothing billed without a record you can open and check.
One merchant's catalog, conversations, and quiz data are never reachable from another's workspace — even though many stores run on the same platform underneath.
Architected for retail's actual traffic pattern from day one — a flash sale or a viral moment is exactly when a merchant needs it most, not when it should be catching up.
SOC 2 Type II targeted as the merchant base that requires it comes onboard — not claimed before it's earned.

compliance.note: This is the standard we're building to before asking a merchant to put us in front of their customers and their revenue — not a claim that every piece is certified today.

visionHeading: The sale is where we start. Not where we stop.
visionDescription: Every feature we add — cart recovery, guided-discovery quizzes, shopper intelligence, replenishment reminders — is judged the same way: does it hold up as an honest answer to a real shopper, not just something that looks automated. The pricing is a promise about honesty, not an unlimited claim — a fixed platform fee plus a component that only grows when it's tied to something you actually got, never a meter running quietly on raw message volume or a surprise overage bill because traffic spiked for a day. Underneath, the Shopify-specific pieces sit on a commerce engine that isn't tied to one platform — Shopify is where we're proving it first, not where the product ends.

facts.description: Actively onboarding early Shopify merchant design partners, not yet generally available.
Built by a technical founder with production Shopify app and AI-agent experience.
Built for the Shopify Admin API and checkout flow specifically — not a generic widget retrofitted onto it.
The bill tracks a resolved question, a recovered cart, a completed order — never raw message volume.

closingHeadline: Building for Shopify merchants tired of paying twice for the same AI reply.
